mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate indicates a growing economy, which leads to higher consumer spending and increased demand for goods and services, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate below 0.5% signals an easing monetary cycle, leading to increased borrowing and spending, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
